style_name: Obscure Frontier Logistics (2D Cinematic Storybook Stickman)

acts.name: The Paradox Hook
acts.goal: A striking historical paradox: how an entire empire hinged on a daily delivery of salted lard, grain rations, or iron nails at a remote stone outpost.

acts.name: The Fragile Routine
acts.goal: The solitary plebeian or legionary stickman in the damp morning cold, grinding bitter puls or counting wax-sealed transport chits.

acts.name: The Logistical Domino
acts.goal: Deconstruct the micro-mechanisms of ancient survival: grain transport loss on river barges, ox-cart axle wear, rent extortion in tenement insulae, marching rations.

acts.name: The Cold Epilogue
acts.goal: The quiet endurance of common human labor: when monuments crumbled, it was the logistical records on wooden tablets that survived.

flow.character_guide: Minimalist 2D cartoon stick-figure frontier soldier or plebeian character with smooth off-white round head, simple black dot eyes, thin clean stick limbs, wearing authentic coarse wool tunic and cloak with natural fabric folds
flow.look: Wide 2D cinematic storybook illustration, hand-painted matte digital art, European graphic novel aesthetic (bande dessinée / ligne claire), high-end historical documentary art style, uncluttered composition, generous negative space, atmospheric depth. Minimalist stickman frontier soldier or plebeian character with smooth off-white round head, simple black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs, wearing a simple rough coarse-weave wool tunic or cloak with realistically draped fabric folds, holding a wooden spear or wax tablet. Environment: weathered ancient stone wall with fine mortar cracks, dim flickering wall oil lamp casting warm amber glow, arched Roman aqueduct silhouetted in distant dawn haze. Single continuous 16:9 widescreen frame. Single camera view. Absolutely NO comic book panels, NO multi-panel grids, NO split screens, NO borders.

editorial.voice: Immersive, contemplative, and vivid micro-history narrator. Speaks with empathetic, deadpan observation and unhurried pacing. Delivers quiet, rhythmic pauses after revealing the absurd bureaucratic micro-realities of empire maintenance.
rules: Micro-substance: cite real Roman papyri or Vindolanda wooden ink tablets, exact modius grain measurements, sesterce prices, and calorie tallies of legionary posca vinegar water.
Visceral sensory reality: the grease of unwashed wool cloaks, the freezing dampness of basalt cobblestones, the clinking of iron mule shoes at 4 AM.
Zero fluff: no broad historical summaries. Begin directly with a soldier shivering over an unpaid salt chit or an eviction notice on an insula door.
4-Act structure: The Paradox Hook -> The Fragile Routine -> The Logistical Domino -> The Cold Epilogue.
